lines.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Margaret Collins?
Yes, this is Margaret. Who is calling?
Good afternoon. This is David from the fraud department at your bank. We noticed a suspicious transaction of nine hundred dollars on your account.
Oh dear, I didn't make any payment like that.
Don't worry, that's why I'm calling. Your account has been locked for your protection. We need to verify you right now before the payment goes through.
Alright, what do you need?
We just sent a six digit code to your phone. Please read me the code so I can cancel the transaction immediately.
Let me find my phone. It says four, seven...
Yes, go on. And please stay on the line, don't hang up or the money will be lost.
This is officer James Miller calling from the tax department. Is this Robert?
Yes, speaking.
Robert, our records show you owe four thousand dollars in unpaid taxes. There is a warrant for your arrest.
What? I always pay my taxes.
If you do not pay within the next hour, police will come to your house today.
How am I supposed to pay that fast?
You can settle it with Google Play gift cards. Buy them at any store and read me the numbers on the back. Do not tell anyone about this case.
Grandma? Grandma, it's me, your grandson.
Tommy? Is that you? You sound different.
I have a cold. Grandma, I'm in trouble. I was in a car accident and the police arrested me.
Oh my goodness, are you hurt?
I'm okay, but I need bail money, two thousand dollars. My lawyer says you can send it by Western Union.
Should I call your mother?
No, please don't tell mom and dad. Keep this between us, okay? I need it right now.
Hello, I'm calling from Microsoft Windows support. Your computer has sent us an error report.
Really? What kind of error?
Your computer is infected with a dangerous virus and hackers are stealing your files as we speak.
That sounds bad. What should I do?
I will fix it for you. Please download the AnyDesk app so I can get remote access to your computer.
Okay, I'm opening the browser.
Good. After that, log in to your online banking so I can check that the hackers didn't take your money.
Hi, this is Sarah from Bright Smile Dental. Am I speaking with Mr. Ahmed?
Yes, hi Sarah.
I'm just calling to remind you about your cleaning appointment on Thursday at ten in the morning.
Oh right, thank you. Thursday works for me.
Great. Please bring your insurance card, and arrive ten minutes early to fill in a short form.
Sure, I'll be there. Is there parking?
Yes, there is free parking behind the building. See you on Thursday, have a nice day.
Hi Mum, it's Ali. I'm at the bank now, sorting out the car loan.
Oh good. Did they help you?
Yes. I'll transfer the money for your rent tonight, so don't worry about it.
Thank you, beta. My phone got a code this morning, is that from you?
No, that's the bank app on your phone. Never read that code to anyone, even me.
Okay. And I forgot my email password again.
No problem, I'll help you reset it when I visit on Sunday. Love you, Mum.
